Commentary.Commentary: Given the short boundaries and flat nature of the pitch, the Kiwis could fancy their chances to chase it down. Can the Protea bowlers keep their lines and lengths tight? Join us in a bit to see what happens next...

As far as New Zealand are concerned, all the bowlers leaked runs except Trent Boult. His spell was the reason that South Africa couldn't go past the 200-run mark. He allowed only two runs in his last over which included three dots and Behardien's wicket. The Kiwis were also very athletic in the field which saved them at least 7 to 10 runs.

A good batting performance from South Africa has ensured that they ask New Zealand to chase 186. They would defer to agree that the short boundaries also helped. It was Amla who started the assault at the start. His timing was supreme and he maintained that throughout the match. At one time, it felt that the visitors can cross the 200-run mark but wickets kept tumbling at the other end and they failed to do so.
FOUR! Short and sprayed down the leg side, Parnell shuffles across and guides it wide through the short fine leg region for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 185/6.
Wayne Parnell arrives at the crease.

OUT! Leg cutter outside off, Morris goes for a heave and he misses. Duminy wants the strike as he comes running in from the non-striker's end. The keeper picks it up and throws it on the stumps. The ball hits and Duminy keeps walking towards the dug out. Just one ball left in the innings.
Fuller delivery outside off, Morris drives it hard through the cover region for a couple.
Slower delivery on the pads, Morris goes to hit on the leg side but he is beaten by pace. No run taken.
Morris comes down the track early and Southee sees it. He fires it wide outside off and the batsman cannot reach it.
SIX! WHACKED! Short into the body, Morris slaps it with a flat bat over the mid-wicket region for a biggie. That was a top shot.
Tim Southee will bowl the final over.
Swing and a miss. Full delivery and wide, Duminy looks to drive but misses again. Golden over this, only two off it and a wicket. Also a brilliant spell. His figures are 4-0-8-2.
Length ball, outside off, Duminy looks to drive but misses.
Morris drives this length ball through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Morris runs down the track to pull it like McCullum but eventually has to duck to leave it alone.
Slower delivery, outside off, Duminy pushes this through covers and runs one.
Chris Morris will replace Farhaan Behardien in the middle.

OUT! Boult strikes straightaway. Length ball, around off, Behardien gets under it and looks to loft it over long off. But he knows he hasn't connected it well, can clearly understand that after seeing his expression. Anderson cups it easily at long off.
Trent Boult is recalled for a bowl.
Bowls another yorker, Behardien clears his front leg and knocks it through mid on for a single.
The ball is probably lost after that big hit and the umpires have called in for a replacement.

SIX! This time he connects. Short of a length delivery, head height, Behardien swivels across and smacks it over deep square leg for a biggie. Williamson is seen having a word with Wheeler, who's facing the pressure.
Behardien looks to pull this short of length delivery but misses.
Wheeler again follows Duminy, as he lofts this length delivery towards deep mid-wicket. Grandhomme dives to catch it but it falls just short of him. Good effort this by the Kiwi!
SIX! That incident has had no effect on Duminy whatsoever. Wheeler follows Duminy as he shuffles across, but still the batsman manages to smack it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Supreme timing!

NOT OUT! Brilliant stuff this. Reminds me of Bavuma's effort at WACA when he ran David Warner out. Yorker delivery, Duminy jams it somehow towards the leg side and sets off. Wheeler runs towards the ball, grabs it and throws it in one motion in his follow through at the striker's end and it hits. They appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. However, replays show Duminy did well to get inside the crease.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Duminy. It seems pretty close to the naked eye.
Ben Wheeler is back in for a bowl.
Duminy pulls this back of length delivery in front of square to retain the strike. They run a single.
FOUR! Shortish delivery, around leg, Duminy shuffles across and pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. Intelligent batting this from the southpaw.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery, Duminy gets on his toes and cuts it over the point fielder for a boundary. The region was vacant and he uses to his advantage.
Fuller delivery, around middle and leg, Behardien hits it unconvincingly to mid off. One run added to the total!
On a length, around leg, Duminy nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery, around off, Duminy wants to dab it to third man but misses as Ronchi collects it easily.
Tim Southee reintroduced into the attack.
Behardien drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
Knuckle ball just outside off, Behardien tries to push at it but he misses as he is unable to judge the pace of the ball.
Outside off, Duminy guides it towards third man for a single.
Farhaan Behardien is the new man in.

OUT! BIRTHDAY BOY DEPARTS! Full length delivery around off, de Villiers makes room for himself and tries to hit it over the cover fielder. He mistimes it as the ball hits the bottom half of the bat and the goes towards the fielder at mid off. Ben Wheeler makes no mistake as he pouches an easy catch and South Africa have lost their fourth wicket.
SIX! AWAY SHE GOES! On the stumps, AB de Villiers backs away a bit and strikes it hard over the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Short into the body, de Villiers plays a tennis ball shot straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Colin de Grandhomme is back into the attack.
Outside off, ABD reaches to the pitch of the delivery and drives it through covers to keep strike.
Down the leg side, Duminy clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Floated up, de Villiers drives it down the ground towards long off for a single.
On the pads, Duminy clips it on the leg side for a quick single.
SIX! Tossed up in the line of the stumps, Duminy dances down the track and smacks it straight over the bowler's head for a biggie. That was way into the stands.
Tossed up on the stumps, Duminy plays it late and fine through the off side for a couple.
Length delivery, outside off, ABD looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Length delivery, down the leg side, ABD hops and tickles it fine for a boundary. Poor this from Wheeler. He should know AB will put those away all day long.
Jean-Paul Duminy walks out in the middle.

OUT! A fantastic innings comes to an end. Wheeler bangs this short and it gets too big for Amla. He looks to pull it but miscues it in front of square. Tom Bruce runs in a bit from deep square leg and pouches it safely.  ABD pats him on the body to acknowledge his knock.
Short of a length, angling, in, de Villiers flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Full delivery, outside off, asking to be punished and ABD agrees. Drives it through the vacant cover region for a boundary!
Back of a length delivery, outside off, ABD looks to cut it past point but misses.
Outside off and a bit short, de Villiers cuts it through point for a single.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE! On the pads, de Villiers shuffles across and scoops it over the square leg region for a boundary.
A good passage of play for the Kiwis. They are bowling good lines and lengths and keeping it tight. But with AB de Villiers at the crease, the South Africans will expect fireworks from him.
Amla drives it through covers for a single.

STUMPING MISSED AND FOUR BYES! Floated delivery, Amla dances down the track and goes for a biggie. He misses it completely and so does the keeper. The ball races away behind him for a boundary. Ronchi has given life to the dangerous looking Amla. Can the latter make the most of it?
On the pads, de Villiers clips it through square leg for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
De Villiers drives it through covers for a single and retains strike.
Short delivery and Amla pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, AB de Villiers drives it towards long on for another single.
Outside off, Amla drives it towards long on for a single.

Outside off, de Villiers drives it towards mid off and goes for a quick single. Williamson hares across to his right, picks it up and goes for a quick throw at the non-striker's end. But he fails to hit and de Villiers is safe. Had it been a direct hit, it might have been curtains for de Villiers.
Birthday boy AB de Villiers has arrived at the crease.

OUT! Faf du Plessis departs! Slower full toss on the stumps, Faf shuffles across and goes for a scoop. He misses it completely as he is deceived for pace and the ball hits the pads. The players appeal for an LBW and the umpire has given it out. Faf departs after getting a chance. The 87-run partnership comes to an end.
Colin de Grandhomme is back into the attack.
Short delivery into the body, Amla goes to ramp it over the keeper but misses. Quality over from Boult.
A mistimed short towards long on helps du Plessis get a single.
Outside off, Amla guides it towards third man for a single.

DROPPED! Back of a length delivery, Faf dances down the track and goes for a pull. He gets a top edge and the ball balloons in the air. Three fielder come close in to catch the ball towards short third man. Santner comes from point to catch it but he cannot hold onto it. A simple chance goes down. One run taken. This could prove to be a costly miss.
Good length delivery outside off, Faf shuffles across and goes for a scoop but misses.
Angling in from a length, Amla tries to pull it but the ball goes towards long on after getting the inside half of the bat. A single is taken.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Full delivery, angling in, du Plessis looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Yorker, finally! Faf does well to dig it out.
Length delivery, around off, Amla smashes it past the bowler and runs one.
SIX! Wow! Mistimes are going for maximums. A match which bowlers won't enjoy much. Length delivery, around off, Amla whacks it over long off for a biggie.
Amla drives this length delivery to covers.
6th T20I fifty for Hashim Amla.
FOUR! FIFTY UP FOR AMLA! Good length delivery, outside off, Amla cuts it through point for a boundary. Top knock this, he's looking in great touch.
Colin Munro is brought into the attack.
SIX! Another one for Faf! Comes down the track and smacks it down the ground for a maximum! Expensive over this, 16 off it!
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Faf gets to the pitch of the ball and knocks it long on for a single.
SIX! Tossed up delivery, Faf dances down the track and lofts it over long on. Too difficult for Wheeler to catch it and naturally goes over him.
Short and around off, Amla pulls it with one hand through mid-wicket and runs one.
Slower in the air, on the sticks, Faf goes back and cuts it towards point and steals a single.
Length delivery, Faf backs away and lofts it towards mid off. Williamson makes a good save there to stop a certain boundary. One run added to the total!
Amla drives this length delivery through covers for a single.
Length delivery, outside off, Amla cuts it through point and runs two.
TWO WIDES! Short and way over the keeper, he jumps but it is impossible for him to collect. The third man runs across to cut it off. They run a single.
50-run stand between Hashim Amla and Faf du Plessis.
Length delivery, around middle and off, Amla flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery, on leg, du Plessis wants to work it around but only manages to get a leading edge through mid off. One run added to the total!
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Faf tucks it off his hips through fine leg and runs two.
Colin de Grandhomme is into the attack!
Looped up delivery, on the sticks, Faf eases it down to long on. One run added to the total!
Amla works this around through square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery, outside off, Faf cuts it through point for a single.
Amla flicks this floated delivery through mid-wicket and runs one.

Sprays this one on the pads, Amla looks to work it around but it hits his pad and goes towards the leg side. Amla wants a run but the keeper does well to throw it back to the bowler to deny the single.
Tosses this outside off, Faf gets a stride forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Time for spin. Mitchell Santner comes into the attack!
Short into the body, Amla stands tall and defends the last ball of the over.
FOUR! Short into the body, Amla pulls it hard through the square leg region. The ball races away to the boundary. No fielder has a chance to stop it.
FOUR! On the pads, Amla clips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary. He has gone crazy and scoring boundaries at will.
Outside off, du Plessis pushes it towards the fielder at point for a quick single. The fielder there has a really bad throw towards the keeper's end.
FOUR! Slower delivery outside off, Faf gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it elegantly through the cover region for a boundary.
Short into the body, Amla guides it late towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Amla clips it late down the leg side to keep strike. 17 runs of the over.
On the pads, Amla clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! 4th in a row! Back of a length delivery outside off, Amla cuts it through the diving point fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Amla flicks it through the fine leg region to make it three of three. Another top shot to get another boundary.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Length delivery outside off, Amla camps back and drives it through the cover region for another boundary. Amla is on the charge.
FOUR! LUCKY! On a good length, angling away, Amla goes hard at it and the ball catches the outside edge and goes between the keeper and the wide first slip. The ball races away to the boundary.
Ben Wheeler has a change of ends.

SIX! Full delivery, on the sticks, Faf shuffles across, uses the pace of the ball and scoops it fine for a 51 metres maximum. Pretty short boundaries and that's what you expect in New Zealand. One thing I assure is that both teams won't mind it! Outstanding improvisation and the batsman gets the result.
Marginally ahead of length, around off, Faf stays in his crease and defends it right under his eye line.
Length delivery, outside off, Faf swings and misses! Risky shot this by the South African!
On a length, outside off, Faf lofts it over covers but doesn't quite connect it. The cover fielder chases it as they run two.
Length ball, outside off, du Plessis looks to pat it to third man but misses. Southee thinks he's nicked it and goes up. However, nor the umpires neither his teammates are interested.
Short of a length delivery, Amla hops and nudges towards leg side for a single.
WIDE! Back of a length delivery, going down the leg side, Amla leaves it alone. Poor delivery to start off for Southee.
Change in bowling. Tim Southee comes into the attack.
Good length delivery slanting across du Plessis. He doesn't fiddle with it. Great over from Boult, a wicket and only a run from it.
Very full delivery outside off, Faf lunges forward and drives it crisply to the man at mid off. Boult has been right on the money today.
Faf du Plessis is the next man in.

OUT! BIG WICKET! Back of a length delivery outside off, Quinton de Kock shuffles across and pulls it over the square leg region. Santner at deep square leg does not have to move even a bit as the ball comes straight to him for an easy catch. He doesn't miss those and Boult has drawn first blood in this encounter. De Kock has to walk back for a duck after struggling in the middle for a bit.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon. Ben Wheeler comes running from third man to dive and stop the boundary. Just one run taken.
Outside off on a length, Amla pushes it towards the fielder at point.
On a good length outside off, Amla tries to defend it but the ball sneaks it between the bat and the body. Lucky escape.
Good length outside off, Quinton tries to slash at it but he is beaten due to the extra bounce.
De Kock lunges forward and defends the ball on the off side.
Outside off, Amla stays in his crease and pushes it on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Outside off on a back of a length, Amla stays deep in his crease and cuts it over the fielder at point for another boundary. TOP SHOT!
FOUR! On the pads, Amla whips it hard over the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Again down the leg side, Amla tries to flick it but misses. The ball goes straight to the keeper. Strange call to not signal it as a wide.
Ben Wheeler will share the new ball with Trent Boult.

Huge appeal for LBW! Angling in from a length which nips in a bit. Kock tries to clip it on the leg side but misses as he gets hit low on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire denies. This bowl was surely going down the leg side.
On the pads, Hashim clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Very full around off, the ball nips back in. Amla tries to defend it but he finds an inside edge onto the pads.
Outside off on a good length, Amla stays deep in his crease and pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
FOUR LEG BYES! Again bowled down the leg side, Amla tries to clip it it but he fails to make contact. The ball hits him low on the pads and goes past the keeper for the first boundary of the match.
Down the leg side, Amla shuffles a bit and nudges it towards the fielder at square leg. No run taken.
The players are out and warming up at the centre. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock too have arrived at the crease. Trent Boult, as expected, takes the new ball for New Zealand.
South Africa XI - Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock(w), AB de Villiers, Faf du Plessis(c), Jean-Paul Duminy, Farhaan Behardien, Chris Morris, Wayne Parnell, Andile Phehlukwayo, Imran Tahir, Dane Paterson.
New Zealand XI - Glenn Phillips, Kane Williamson(c), Colin Munro, Tom Bruce, Corey Anderson, Colin de Grandhomme, Luke Ronchi(w), Mitchell Santner, Ben Wheeler, Tim Southee, Trent Boult.

Toss - New Zealand win the toss and elect to field first. The hosts have handed a debut to the youngster Glenn Phillips while Dane Paterson who replaced Dwaine Pretorius also gets his first cap for the visitors.

Hello and a warm welcome for the only T20I between New Zealand and South Africa. Both the teams have been clinical at their homes in the ODIs and will want to continue their rich vein of form. The fact that the Proteas have a very good record against the Kiwis in this format, might just give them the edge. On the other hand, the hosts have lost only a single T20I game in their last 10 matches and would look to continue with the momentum. The weather conditions weren't good as it was raining a while ago but for now it has cleared and let's hope it stays the same throughout. Expect it to be a cracker. Join us in a while for the toss and team updates...
